title_tag: 美国柴油涨破6美元，川川“铁票仓”先急了：为什么柴油价格能搅动中期选举？—— 美国CNN外刊讲解第1182天
h1: 美国柴油涨破6美元，川川“铁票仓”先急了：为什么柴油价格能搅动中期选举？
category: 美国CNN外刊讲解 第1182天
nav_hint: Pain at the pump, MAGA base rattled

headline.en_html: Soaring diesel prices are <mark class="voc">clobbering</mark> Trump’s MAGA <mark class="voc">faithful</mark>, exposing <mark class="voc">rifts</mark> — Pain at the <mark class="voc">pump</mark> for rural Republicans is shifting the political map
headline.zh: 柴油价格飙升重创特朗普的MAGA铁杆票仓，裂痕已然显现——乡村共和党人的加油之痛，正在改写政治版图

notes.en: to hit someone or something very hard, or to defeat someone decisively; to affect someone very badly
notes.ctx: 标题没用 hurt 或 raise，而用 clobber——柴油涨价不是“影响”谁，是照着铁杆支持者一顿闷棍，谁疼谁知道。
notes.ex1: Rising interest rates have clobbered first-time homebuyers this year. 今年利率上升沉重打击了首次购房者。
notes.ex2: The team was clobbered 5-0 in the final match. 该队在决赛中以0比5惨败。

notes.en: people who are loyal supporters of a person, organization, or belief
notes.zh: 忠实支持者，铁杆拥护者
notes.ctx: 形容词加 the 当集合名词用，指“铁杆那一群”；the MAGA faithful 就是特朗普最死忠、最不容易跑的那批票。
notes.ex1: The party's faithful gathered in the convention hall to hear the leader's speech. 该党的忠实支持者聚集在会议厅聆听领袖演讲。
notes.ex2: He remained one of the team's most loyal faithful even during its worst seasons. 即使在球队最糟糕的赛季，他仍是最忠实的支持者之一。

notes.en: a serious disagreement that divides people who were previously united
notes.ctx: 本义是岩层上被撕开的一道缝，用在党内就是“原本一条心的人被劈开”，副标题说这场油价危机正撕开共和党。
notes.ex1: The new policy has created a deep rift within the party. 新政策在党内制造了深深的裂痕。
notes.ex2: The dispute over the budget widened the rift between the two allies. 预算争端加深了两个盟友之间的裂痕。

notes.en: a machine at a gas station that dispenses fuel; used in the phrase “pain at the pump” to refer to the financial burden of high gasoline or diesel prices
notes.ctx: pain at the pump 是英语惯用语，把加油枪当成“痛点”的代名词，一句就把油价之苦写得有画面。
notes.ex1: With gas prices hitting new highs, pain at the pump is a top concern for voters. 随着油价创下新高，加油之痛成为选民最关心的问题。
notes.ex2: The president promised to ease pain at the pump by releasing oil from strategic reserves. 总统承诺通过释放战略石油储备来缓解加油之痛。

paragraphs.en_html: Diesel prices soaring to <mark class="voc">record</mark> highs this past week have caused Republican candidates in <mark class="voc">solid-red</mark> parts of the country to call for an end to President Donald Trump’s war with Iran and for a ban on diesel exports, as the issue <mark class="voc">rattles</mark> the party’s MAGA base in a way that few have in this midterm election year. “Michigan families are struggling with the price of everyday life,” Mike Rogers, the state’s GOP <mark class="voc">nominee</mark> for U.S. Senate, said in an ad this past week.
paragraphs.zh: 过去一周，柴油价格飙升至历史新高，令全国深红选区的共和党候选人纷纷呼吁结束特朗普总统对伊朗的战争，并禁止柴油出口。这一议题在这个中期选举年撼动了该党MAGA基本盘，其烈度鲜有匹敌者。“密歇根的家庭正在为日常生活的开销苦苦挣扎，”该州共和党联邦参议员候选人迈克·罗杰斯在过去一周的一则广告中说道。

notes.en: the highest or lowest level that has ever been achieved or recorded
notes.ctx: 名词 record（纪录）直接拿来当定语，record highs 就是“有记录以来的最高位”，比 very high 有分量。
notes.ex1: The country experienced record temperatures this summer. 该国今年夏天经历了创纪录的高温。
notes.ex2: The company reported record profits in the fourth quarter. 该公司报告第四季度利润创下纪录。

notes.en: (of a voting district) overwhelmingly supporting the Republican Party, with little chance of voting for Democrats
notes.zh: 深红的，共和党铁票仓的
notes.ctx: 美国政治红色代表共和党、蓝色代表民主党，solid 是“铁板一块”，solid-red 就是民主党想都别想的选区。
notes.ex1: The senator easily won reelection in her solid-red state. 这位参议员在她的深红州轻松赢得连任。
notes.ex2: Even in solid-red districts, voters are expressing frustration over rising costs. 即使在深红选区，选民也对不断上涨的成本表达不满。

notes.en: to make someone nervous, worried, or unsettled; to shake or disturb
notes.ctx: 原义是“哗啦哗啦地响”，引申为把人心里搅得发慌；此处指柴油议题动摇了基本盘那种稳如磐石的支持。
notes.ex1: The unexpected poll results rattled the campaign team. 出人意料的民调结果令竞选团队感到不安。
notes.ex2: The scandal has rattled investors' confidence in the company. 丑闻动摇了投资者对公司的信心。

notes.en: a person who has been formally chosen as a candidate for an election or position
notes.ctx: 来自 nominate（提名），指党内正式推出、披挂上阵的那个人，本文即密歇根州共和党提名的联邦参议员候选人。
notes.ex1: The party's presidential nominee will be announced at the convention. 该党的总统候选人将在全国代表大会上公布。
notes.ex2: She is the Democratic nominee for governor in a closely contested state. 她是在一个竞争激烈的州获得民主党提名的州长候选人。

paragraphs.en_html: The war has sent oil prices surging, with <mark class="voc">disruptions</mark> to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a <mark class="voc">vital</mark> route for global energy supplies, <mark class="voc">reverberating</mark> through fuel markets. But while poll after poll has shown voters concerned about the cost of gasoline, it’s the price of diesel — a far less obvious consumer product — that has <mark class="voc">riled up</mark> the industrial and agricultural interests that have been among the most faithful Republican supporters.
paragraphs.zh: 这场战争导致油价飙升，霍尔木兹海峡——全球能源供应的咽喉要道——航运受阻，冲击波已在整个燃料市场回荡。然而，尽管一份又一份民调显示选民担忧汽油价格，真正激怒了工业与农业利益集团的，却是柴油——一种远不那么引人注目的消费品——的价格。而这些利益集团，恰恰是共和党最忠实的支持者群体。

notes.en: a disturbance that interrupts or prevents something from continuing normally
notes.ctx: dis- 打散 + rupt 断裂，航运“断链”就是 disruption；海峡一卡，整条能源供应链就被掐住。
notes.ex1: The strike caused widespread disruption to train services across the country. 罢工导致全国火车服务大范围中断。
notes.ex2: Supply chain disruptions during the pandemic led to shortages of many goods. 疫情期间的供应链中断导致许多商品短缺。

notes.en: extremely important and necessary for something to succeed or exist
notes.zh: 至关重要的，必不可少的
notes.ctx: 词根 vita 是“生命”，vital route 就是命脉通道，霍尔木兹对全球能源供应正是这个级别。
notes.ex1: Access to clean water is vital for public health. 获得清洁水源对公共健康至关重要。
notes.ex2: The port plays a vital role in the region's economy. 该港口在该地区经济中发挥着至关重要的作用。

notes.en: (of an event or idea) to have a wide-ranging and lasting effect; to echo repeatedly
notes.ctx: 声音撞墙后一层层返回来，用来写冲击“荡开去”；海峡受阻的影响就这样传遍整个燃料市场。
notes.ex1: The effects of the financial crisis reverberated around the world for years. 金融危机的影响在世界各地回荡了数年之久。
notes.ex2: The Supreme Court's decision will reverberate through the entire healthcare system. 最高法院的裁决将在整个医疗保健系统中产生深远影响。

notes.en: to make someone angry or excited; to stir up strong emotions
notes.ctx: 比 anger 更口语、更带火气，指把一群人“点着”；文中被点着的，正是工业与农业利益集团。
notes.ex1: The controversial remarks riled up the crowd at the rally. 争议性言论激怒了集会上的群众。
notes.ex2: Talk of raising taxes always riles up the party's base. 一提加税总是会激怒该党的基本盘。

paragraphs.en_html: The political <mark class="voc">fallout</mark> is <mark class="voc">landing in</mark> deep-red voting districts the hardest. Federal data shows these tend to be the places where diesel <mark class="voc">makes up</mark> the largest proportion of the overall <mark class="voc">fuel mix</mark>. This is especially the case in farming communities, where diesel powers the fuel-thirsty <mark class="voc">tractors</mark> and other <mark class="voc">machinery</mark> that the agriculture industry relies on.
paragraphs.zh: 政治冲击波正狠狠地砸向深红选区。联邦数据显示，这些地区的柴油在整体燃料结构中所占比例往往最高。农业社区尤为如此——柴油驱动着耗油量惊人的拖拉机和其他机械，是农业产业赖以运转的命脉。

notes.en: the negative consequences or aftereffects of a significant event or situation
notes.ctx: 原指核爆之后飘落的放射性尘埃，用在政坛就是一场风波溅出的碎片，落到谁头上谁疼。
notes.ex1: The fallout from the scandal forced the CEO to resign. 丑闻的余波迫使首席执行官辞职。
notes.ex2: The economic fallout of the war is being felt across the region. 战争的经济余波正在整个地区蔓延。

notes.en: to arrive at or affect a particular place or group, especially with force or impact
notes.ctx: 用“落地”写冲击的落点，landing in ... the hardest 就是“砸得最重的地方”，方向和力度全在一个动词里。
notes.ex1: The blame for the failure landed squarely on the manager's shoulders. 失败的责任直接落到了经理肩上。
notes.ex2: The new regulations will land hardest on small businesses. 新法规将对小企业造成最严重的冲击。

notes.en: to form or constitute a particular proportion or part of something
notes.ctx: 此处既不是“化妆”也不是“和好”，而是“占多大比重”，后面通常接比例。
notes.ex1: Women make up more than half of the company's workforce. 女性占该公司员工总数的一半以上。
notes.ex2: Agriculture makes up a significant portion of the state's economy. 农业占该州经济的重要部分。

notes.en: the combination of different types of fuel used in a particular area or system
notes.ctx: mix 是“配比”，一个地区烧什么、各占多少就是它的 fuel mix；深红区这份配比里柴油最重。
notes.ex1: The country is trying to shift its fuel mix toward renewable sources. 该国正试图将其燃料结构转向可再生能源。
notes.ex2: Diesel accounts for a larger share of the fuel mix in rural areas. 柴油在农村地区的燃料结构中占比更大。

notes.en: a powerful motor vehicle used on farms for pulling machinery and plowing fields
notes.ctx: 词根 trahere 是“拉”，拖拉机就是“拉东西的机器”；它与联合收割机一起，构成农业里的油老虎。
notes.ex1: The farmer spent the morning driving his tractor across the fields. 农民一上午都开着拖拉机在田间劳作。
notes.ex2: Modern tractors are equipped with GPS for precision farming. 现代拖拉机配备了GPS以实现精准农业。

notes.en: machines collectively, especially those used in industry or agriculture
notes.ctx: 不可数的集合名词，指“机械的总和”，不能说 a machinery；农业靠的就是这一整套机械。
notes.ex1: The factory invested in new machinery to increase production. 工厂投资购买新机械以提高产量。
notes.ex2: Heavy machinery is required to harvest the crops efficiently. 高效收割庄稼需要重型机械。

paragraphs.en_html: That has led <mark class="voc">lawmakers</mark> to demand what was unthinkable in the GOP only a couple of months ago: a ban on diesel exports from the United States. The proposal seems to make sense <mark class="voc">on its face</mark>: restrict the flow of the fuel out of the U.S. to boost the supply domestically, quickly lowering prices. The problem is that almost nobody who understands oil markets — including Energy Secretary Chris Wright — believes it would work out that way. Analysts who have been <mark class="voc">modeling</mark> the impact of a diesel export ban are consistently warning it would create <mark class="voc">chaos</mark> and hurt consumers.
paragraphs.zh: 这促使议员们提出了几个月前在共和党内还不可想象的主张：禁止美国出口柴油。这一提议表面上似乎合情合理：限制燃料外流以增加国内供应，从而迅速压低价格。问题在于，几乎所有真正懂石油市场的人——包括能源部长克里斯·赖特——都不认为它会奏效。一直在建模分析柴油出口禁令影响的分析师们一致警告：此举将制造混乱，伤害消费者。

notes.en: a person who makes laws; a member of a legislative body
notes.ctx: law + maker 直译“造法的人”，是议员的中性说法，比 congressman 更不挑党派。
notes.ex1: Lawmakers debated the bill for hours before voting. 议员们就法案辩论了数小时后才投票。
notes.ex2: The lawmaker introduced legislation to lower prescription drug prices. 这位议员提出立法以降低处方药价格。

notes.en: based on a first impression or superficial examination, without considering deeper complexities
notes.ctx: 法律用语，只看纸面、不问内里；作者用它给后面的反转埋钉子——看着合理的禁令其实行不通。
notes.ex1: On its face, the proposal seems reasonable, but it has hidden costs. 从表面上看，该提议似乎合理，但存在隐性成本。
notes.ex2: The argument is compelling on its face but falls apart under scrutiny. 该论点表面上很有说服力，但经不起推敲。

notes.en: to simulate or predict the effects of something using a mathematical or analytical system
notes.ctx: 名词“模型”作动词，指先把政策后果用数据算一遍，比 predict 多一层“有模型撑着”的底气。
notes.ex1: Economists modeled the impact of the tax cut on growth. 经济学家建模分析了减税对增长的影响。
notes.ex2: Researchers are modeling how climate change will affect crop yields. 研究人员正在建模分析气候变化将如何影响作物产量。

notes.en: a state of complete disorder and confusion
notes.ctx: 希腊语里指宇宙成形之前的那团混沌，程度远重于 mess；分析师说禁令一出就是市场大乱。
notes.ex1: The power outage caused chaos across the city. 停电在全城造成混乱。
notes.ex2: The sudden policy change threw the market into chaos. 政策的突然变化使市场陷入混乱。

paragraphs.en_html: The Gulf Coast <mark class="voc">refineries</mark> that typically export diesel abroad would get <mark class="voc">overloaded</mark> with <mark class="voc">a glut of</mark> crude that would have to <mark class="voc">be diverted to</mark> storage. The diesel they make would mostly be <mark class="voc">stranded</mark> in their region, because there are no pipelines to get it across the country. Parts of the country that rely on imports of diesel could then see prices soar even higher than they are now. “It is not at all clear that the national price of diesel would fall,” the Energy Policy Research Foundation said Thursday in a report.
paragraphs.zh: 通常向海外出口柴油的墨西哥湾沿岸炼油厂，将因大量原油无处可去而陷入过剩，只能转为储存。它们生产的柴油也将大部分困守本地区，因为没有管道将其输送到全国各地。而那些依赖柴油进口的地区，价格反而可能比现在涨得更凶。“全国柴油价格是否会下降，完全说不准，”能源政策研究基金会周四在一份报告中表示。

notes.en: a factory where raw materials such as crude oil are processed into usable products like gasoline or diesel
notes.ctx: refine（提炼）加 -ery（场所），把原油炼成汽柴油的地方；墨西哥湾沿岸是全球炼油的心脏地带。
notes.ex1: The refinery processes thousands of barrels of crude oil per day. 该炼油厂每天加工数千桶原油。
notes.ex2: A fire at the refinery forced the company to halt production. 炼油厂火灾迫使公司停止生产。

notes.en: carrying or supplied with more than can be handled or accommodated
notes.ctx: over- 过量 + load 装载，货多到装不下；禁令一堵，炼油厂先被自己的原油压垮。
notes.ex1: The electrical system was overloaded and caused a blackout. 电力系统超负荷导致停电。
notes.ex2: Trucks were overloaded with goods during the holiday season. 假日期间卡车超载运货。

notes.en: an excessive supply or amount of something, more than what is needed
notes.ctx: glut 专指“供过于求的堆积”，是经济学意义上的过剩，正好说清禁令造成的原油淤积。
notes.ex1: A glut of cheap imports drove local producers out of business. 大量廉价进口商品迫使本地生产商倒闭。
notes.ex2: There is a glut of office space in the city center. 市中心办公空间过剩。

notes.en: to be redirected or channeled to a different place or purpose
notes.ctx: di- 分开 + vert 转，本该出口的原油被“改道”进储油罐，一个动词写尽禁令的副作用。
notes.ex1: The funds were diverted to other projects without approval. 这些资金未经批准就被转用于其他项目。
notes.ex2: Traffic was diverted to side streets during the road construction. 道路施工期间交通被疏导到小街上。

notes.en: to leave someone or something in a place from which they cannot leave or be moved
notes.ctx: 原义“搁浅”，船卡在沙滩上动不了；柴油因没有管道被困在产区，正是这个画面。
notes.ex1: The storm stranded hundreds of travelers at the airport. 暴风雨使数百名旅客滞留在机场。
notes.ex2: The broken-down bus stranded passengers on the highway for hours. 抛锚的巴士使乘客在高速公路上滞留了数小时。
